C1470.title: NHTSA Opens Safety Probe into Tesla Autopilot After 11 Crashes with Parked Emergency Vehicles Result in One Fatality
C1470.summary: In August 2021, the U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration opened a safety investigation into Tesla’s Autopilot driver-assistance system. Investigation documents and reports state that the incidents involved Teslas operating with Autopilot engaged striking stationary emergency vehicles with warning lights activated. The probe covered multiple models and a large vehicle population, exposing safety risks around static-obstacle recognition and driver supervision. The investigation did not treat the vehicles as fully autonomous; it emphasized that driver-assistance systems still depend on continuous driver supervision. When both system perception and driver attention are insufficient for stationary emergency vehicles, the consequences can be amplified.
